m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √ruc

hindi: दिखाई देता हुआ, चमकीला रुक्म विस्तार से दमका; शोभा के लिए दीप्त होता हुआ, दुःसह आयु वाला। अग्नि जीवन-शक्तियों के साथ अमर हो गया, जब उत्तम बीज वाले द्यौ ने उसे उत्पन्न किया।
english: Visible, the bright rukma shone forth widely, a life hard to bear, shining for splendour. Agni became immortal with vital powers, when Heaven, of good seed, begot him.
notes: rukma (bright ornament) and vayas (vital powers; also food or birds) are rendered literally; the construction of durmarṣam āyuḥ (acc. "hard to bear life") is unclear and may qualify rukma or be an object; alternatives not resolved. The unit repeats at 25.

hindi: रात और उषा, एक मन वाली, भिन्न रूपों वाली, मिलकर एक शिशु को दूध पिलाती हैं। द्यावा और क्षामा के भीतर रुक्म चमकता है; धन देने वाले देवों ने अग्नि को धारण किया।
english: Night and Dawn, of one mind and of different forms, together nurse the one child. Between Heaven and Earth the rukma shines forth; the wealth-giving gods held Agni.
notes: dhāpayete: "suckle" (caus. of √dhe) taken literally. antar vi bhāti: "shines within/between" taken with dyāvākṣāmā; the sense of kṣāmā as "earth" is taken from usage. dhārayan is an augmentless 3 pl. form (read as past).

hindi: कवि सब रूपों को धारण करता है; उसने दो पैर वाले और चार पैर वाले के लिए कल्याणकारी को प्रेरित किया। श्रेष्ठ सविता ने आकाश को प्रकाशित किया और उषाओं के प्रयाण के पीछे चमकता है।
english: The seer puts on all forms; he has impelled what is good for the two-footed and the four-footed. Savitṛ, the excellent, has lit up the firmament and shines forth after the course of the dawns.
notes: nāka rendered "firmament"; the glossary renders nāka as heaven (स्वर्ग) in Hindi only where required, here the Hindi uses आकाश for the literal "vault"; vi akhyat read as "lit up". Alternative: "looked upon".

hindi: तुम सुन्दर पंखों वाले हो, पंखों वाले हो; त्रिवृत् तुम्हारा सिर है, गायत्र आँख है, बृहत् और रथन्तर दोनों पंख हैं। स्तोम आत्मा है, छन्द अंग हैं, यजुस् नाम हैं; साम तुम्हारा शरीर है, वामदेव्य और यज्ञायज्ञिय पूँछ हैं, धिष्ण्य खुर हैं। तुम सुन्दर पंखों वाले हो, पंखों वाले हो; आकाश की ओर जाओ, स्वर् में उड़ो।
english: You are fair-winged, winged; the trivṛt is your head, the gāyatra your eye, the bṛhat and rathantara your two wings. The stoma is the self, the metres are the limbs, the yajus formulas are the name; the sāman is your body, the vāmadevya and yajñāyajñiya are the tail, the dhiṣṇyas are the hooves. You are fair-winged, winged; go to the sky, fly to the light.
notes: Suparṇa and garutmat are rendered as adjectives ("fair-winged", "winged") because the line states no identity. dhiṣṇyāḥ and śapāḥ are uncertain: dhiṣṇya (hearth/seat) kept transliterated; śapa rendered "hoof"; svar rendered "light" (could be heaven). The sentence "you are the stoma..." forms: stomaḥ ātmā etc. Taken with te as owner of all items.

words.gloss: of the one acting as a foe
of the one acting as an enemy

hindi: तुम विष्णु के पद-क्रम हो, शत्रुओं को मारने वाले; गायत्र छन्द पर चढ़ो, पृथ्वी के साथ-साथ पग बढ़ाओ। तुम विष्णु के पद-क्रम हो, विरोधियों को मारने वाले; त्रैष्टुभ छन्द पर चढ़ो, अन्तरिक्ष के साथ-साथ पग बढ़ाओ। तुम विष्णु के पद-क्रम हो, शत्रु जैसा आचरण करने वाले के हन्ता; जागत छन्द पर चढ़ो, द्यौ के साथ-साथ पग बढ़ाओ। तुम विष्णु के पद-क्रम हो, शत्रु बनने वाले के हन्ता; आनुष्टुभ छन्द पर चढ़ो, दिशाओं के साथ-साथ पग बढ़ाओ।
english: You are the stride of Viṣṇu, slayer of rivals; mount the gāyatra metre; stride out along the earth. You are the stride of Viṣṇu, slayer of enemies; mount the traiṣṭubha metre; stride out along the airy space. You are the stride of Viṣṇu, slayer of one who acts as a foe; mount the jāgata metre; stride out along the sky. You are the stride of Viṣṇu, slayer of one who acts as an enemy; mount the anuṣṭubh metre; stride out along the directions.
notes: Four parallel formulas. antarikṣa rendered "airy space" for consistency with glossary rajas; ānuṣṭubham read as the vṛddhi derivative of anuṣṭubh. The first line ends with a stray accent mark (kramasva̱), kept in src.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √jan

hindi: अग्नि गरजा, जैसे गरजता हुआ द्यौ; पृथ्वी को चाटता हुआ, वनस्पतियों को सजाता हुआ। तुरन्त उत्पन्न होता हुआ, प्रज्वलित होकर उसने दोनों लोकों को प्रकाशित किया; वह अपनी दीप्ति से भीतर चमकता है।
english: Agni roared like thundering Heaven, licking the earth, anointing the plants. Born at once, kindled, he lit up both worlds; with his light he shines within.
notes: vi akhyat ā rodasī: "lit up the two worlds" is the plain rendering; "looked over" is the alternative. Same text as units 21 and 33. vīrudh rendered "plants" (growing things).

hindi: हे अग्नि, लौटने वाले, मेरी ओर लौट आओ, आयु, तेज, सन्तान और धन के साथ; लाभ, मेधा, सम्पत्ति और पोषण के साथ।
english: O Agni, returning one, turn back towards me with life, brilliance, offspring and wealth; with gain, wisdom, riches and nourishment.
notes: sanyā is uncertain (instrumental of sani "gain, gift"); abhyāvartin "returning one" taken as a vocative epithet.

hindi: हे अग्नि, हे अङ्गिरस्, तुम्हारे सौ आवर्तन हों, तुम्हारे हजार उपावर्तन हों। तब पोषण के पोषण के साथ जो हमारा खोया हुआ है उसे फिर हमारे लिए ले आओ; फिर हमारे लिए सम्पत्ति ले आओ।
english: O Agni, O Aṅgiras, may you have a hundred turnings and a thousand returnings. Then, with the nourishment of nourishment, bring back to us what is lost; bring us wealth again.
notes: āvṛt and upāvṛt rendered "turnings" and "returnings". ā kṛdhi rendered "bring"; "make" is the literal alternative. Aṅgiras kept as a name in the vocative.

hindi: फिर रस और बल के साथ लौट आओ; हे अग्नि, फिर ताजगी और आयु के साथ। फिर हमें कष्ट से बचाओ।
english: Turn back again with sap and strength; again, O Agni, with refreshment and life. Protect us again from distress.
notes: iṣ rendered "refreshment"; aṃhas rendered "distress".

hindi: धन के साथ लौट आओ, हे अग्नि; धारा के साथ उमड़ो, विश्वप्स्न्या, सब ओर से।
english: Turn back together with wealth, O Agni; swell with a stream, viśvapsnyā, from all sides.
notes: viśvapsnyā is an obscure form (agreeing with dhārayā, perhaps "all-nourishing"); kept transliterated, not translated as fact.

hindi: मैं तुम्हें ले आया हूँ; तुम भीतर रहे हो; स्थिर खड़े रहो, अचल रहो। सभी कुल तुम्हें चाहें; तुमसे राष्ट्र न खिसके।
english: I have brought you; you have been within; stand firm, unwavering. May all the clans desire you; may the kingdom not fall away from you.
notes: The first token joins seven words; avicācaliḥ "unwavering" (intensive-derived). adhi bhraśat read as "fall from".

hindi: हे वरुण, हमसे ऊपर का पाश, नीचे का पाश और बीच का पाश खोल दो। फिर हे आदित्य, हम तुम्हारे व्रत में अदिति के लिए निष्पाप हों।
english: O Varuṇa, loosen from us the uppermost noose, the lowest, and the middle one. Then, O Āditya, may we be sinless for Aditi in your observance.
notes: ud ... śrathāya is a split verb (tmesis); the three nooses are taken as upper, lowest, middle. Āditya and Aditi kept as names; aditaye could also be read as "for freedom from bonds"; not adopted.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pf. part. nir-√gam

hindi: आगे महान होकर वह उषाओं के ऊपर खड़ा हुआ; अन्धकार से बाहर निकलकर वह ज्योति के साथ आया। अग्नि चमकीली दीप्ति के साथ, सुन्दर अंगों वाला, उत्पन्न होकर सब निवासों को भर गया।
english: In front, great, he stood upright above the dawns; having gone out from the darkness, he came with light. Agni, with bright radiance, fair-limbed, born, has filled all the abodes.
notes: ā ... aprāḥ read as a split verb "filled"; uṣasām ūrdhvaḥ read "upright above the dawns" (alternative: "of the dawns, upright"). aprāḥ could be 2 sg.; taken as 3 sg.

hindi: हंस, उज्ज्वल में बैठने वाला, वसु, अन्तरिक्ष में बैठने वाला, होता, वेदी पर बैठने वाला, अतिथि, घर में बैठने वाला; मनुष्यों में बैठने वाला, वर में बैठने वाला, ऋत में बैठने वाला, आकाश में बैठने वाला, जल में उत्पन्न, गायों से उत्पन्न, ऋत से उत्पन्न, पत्थर से उत्पन्न, महान ऋत।
english: The swan, sitting in the bright, Vasu, sitting in the airy space, the hotṛ, sitting at the altar, the guest, sitting in the house; sitting among men, sitting in the choice place, sitting in order, sitting in the firmament, born in the waters, born of cattle, born of order, born of stone: the great order.
notes: A string of epithets with no verb. haṃsa "swan" (some read "sun"); not adopted. śuci-sad, vara-sad and adri-ja are uncertain in sense (śuci "bright/pure"; vara "choice/boon"; adri "stone, mountain"). The line does not say who is described; none supplied.

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम इस माता की गोद में बैठो, सब मार्गों को जानने वाले। इसे न ताप से, न लौ से जलाओ; इसके भीतर उज्ज्वल ज्योति वाले होकर चमको।
english: Sit, O Agni, in the lap of this mother, knowing all the ways. Do not scorch her with heat or with flame; shine forth within her, of bright light.
notes: vayuna rendered "way" (also "mark, knowledge"). The mother is not identified in the line. abhi śociḥ read as "scorch".

hindi: भीतर, हे अग्नि, अपनी दीप्ति के साथ तुम उखा के अपने आसन में हो। हे जातवेदस्, उसके ऊपर अपने ताप से तपते हुए तुम मंगलकारी बनो।
english: Within, O Agni, with your light, you are in the ukhā's seat, your own. Burning with your heat over her, O Jātavedas, be auspicious.
notes: ukhā kept transliterated; the verb "are" in the first clause is supplied, as the line has none; tasyāḥ "of her" is taken to refer back to the ukhā. Jātavedas kept as a name.

hindi: मेरे लिए मंगलकारी होकर, हे अग्नि, फिर बैठो, तुम मंगलकारी हो। सब दिशाओं को मंगलकारी करके यहाँ अपनी योनि में बैठो।
english: Having become auspicious to me, O Agni, then sit, auspicious as you are. Having made all the directions auspicious, sit here in your own womb.
notes: asadaḥ is an injunctive (2 sg. aor. of √sad) used with imperative sense, rendered "sit"; "auspicious as you are" renders the nominative śivaḥ tvam.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √indh

hindi: आकाश से पहले अग्नि उत्पन्न हुआ; दूसरे स्थान पर हमसे जातवेदस्; तीसरे स्थान पर जलों में, पुरुषों के मन वाला; निरन्तर प्रज्वलित करता हुआ, उत्तम धी वाला इसकी स्तुति करता है।
english: From heaven Agni was born first; second, Jātavedas, from us; third, in the waters, the manly-minded one. Kindling him ceaselessly, the one of good insight praises him.
notes: asmat dvitīyam pari jātavedāḥ: "second, from us, Jātavedas" (the verb jajñe is carried over from the first clause); asmat could be "from here". nṛmaṇāḥ is uncertain ("manly-minded", or "of the mind of men"); kept literal. The kindler and the one praising are the same unnamed subject (indhānaḥ svādhīḥ).

hindi: हे अग्नि, हम तुम्हारे तीन-तीन को तीन प्रकार से जानते हैं; हम तुम्हारे बहुत स्थानों में बँटे हुए धाम जानते हैं। हम तुम्हारा परम नाम गुप्त रूप से जानते हैं; हम उस स्रोत को भी जानते हैं जहाँ से तुम आए हो।
english: O Agni, we know your threes in a threefold way; we know your abodes distributed in many places. We know your supreme name, in secret; and we know that spring from which you came.
notes: tredhā trayāṇi is literal ("threes in three ways"); the line does not say what the threes are. yad vidmā: yat is read as "that" linking the two clauses; alternatives exist.

hindi: समुद्र में, जलों के भीतर, पुरुषों के मन वाले और पुरुषों को देखने वाले ने तुम्हें प्रज्वलित किया, हे अग्नि, आकाश के ऊधस् में। तीसरे क्षेत्र में, जलों की गोद में खड़े तुम को महान् लोगों ने बढ़ाया।
english: In the sea, within the waters, the manly-minded one who watches men kindled you, O Agni, in the udder of heaven. In the third realm, in the lap of the waters, the great ones made you, standing there, grow.
notes: nṛmaṇāḥ and nṛcakṣāḥ ("manly-minded", "watching men") are uncertain and kept literal. mahiṣāḥ "great ones" (could be "buffaloes"); the line identifies none of the agents.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √jan

hindi: अग्नि गरजा, जैसे गरजता हुआ द्यौ; पृथ्वी को चाटता हुआ, वनस्पतियों को सजाता हुआ। तुरन्त उत्पन्न होता हुआ, प्रज्वलित होकर उसने दोनों लोकों को प्रकाशित किया; वह अपनी दीप्ति से भीतर चमकता है।
english: Agni roared like thundering Heaven, licking the earth, anointing the plants. Born at once, kindled, he lit up both worlds; with his light he shines within.
notes: Same text as units 6 and 33 (here without the accent on dyauḥ). vi akhyat ā rodasī: "lit up the two worlds" is the plain rendering; alternative: "looked over".

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pass. √indh

hindi: श्रीणाम् का उदार, धनों का धारण करने वाला, मनीषाओं का प्रार्पण, सोम का रक्षक; वसु, बल का पुत्र, जलों में राजा, उषाओं के आगे प्रज्वलित होता हुआ चमकता है।
english: The udāra of the śrīṇām, supporter of riches, prārpaṇa of insights, guardian of Soma; Vasu, son of might, king in the waters, shines forth in front of the dawns, being kindled.
notes: Obscure terms kept transliterated: śrīṇām, udāra, prārpaṇa. The subject (Agni) is not named in the unit. manīṣā rendered "insight".

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pass. √jan

hindi: सब का केतु, भुवन का गर्भ, उत्पन्न होता हुआ उसने दोनों लोकों को भर दिया। उसने दृढ़ पत्थर को भी तोड़ा, आगे बढ़ते हुए, जब पाँचों जनों ने अग्नि का यजन किया।
english: Banner of all, embryo of the world, being born he filled both worlds. He split even the firm stone as he went forth, when the five peoples worshipped Agni.
notes: In the second line the subject of abhinat is not stated; "he" is the one born in the first line. parāyan janāḥ could instead be read "the peoples, going away"; not adopted. vīḍu "firm, strong thing".

hindi: उत्सुक, पावक, अरति, उत्तम मेधा वाला, मर्त्यों में अमर अग्नि रखा गया है। वह लाल धुआँ ऊपर भेजता है, उसे ढोता हुआ, उज्ज्वल ज्वाला से आकाश तक पहुँचता हुआ।
english: The eager purifier, arati, of good wisdom, immortal Agni, has been placed among mortals. He sends forth the ruddy smoke, bearing it up with bright flame, reaching heaven.
notes: arati is obscure and kept transliterated. "bearing it up" for bharibhrat ut: the object is supplied from dhūmam. pāvaka rendered "purifier".

words.gram: f. inst. sg. used as adv.
m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √ruc

hindi: दिखाई देता हुआ, चमकीला रुक्म विस्तार से दमका; शोभा के लिए दीप्त होता हुआ, दुःसह आयु वाला। अग्नि जीवन-शक्तियों के साथ अमर हो गया, जब उत्तम बीज वाले द्यौ ने उसे उत्पन्न किया।
english: Visible, the bright rukma shone forth widely, a life hard to bear, shining for splendour. Agni became immortal with vital powers, when Heaven, of good seed, begot him.
notes: Repeats unit 1; here vyadyaud and durmarṣam are joined in one token. rukma (bright ornament) and vayas (vital powers; also food or birds) are rendered literally; the construction of durmarṣam āyuḥ is unclear.

hindi: जो आज तुम्हारे लिए घी से भरा पूआ बनाए, हे कल्याणकारी ज्वाला वाले देव, हे अग्नि, उसे आगे ले चलो, श्रेष्ठतर की ओर, देवों द्वारा बाँटे गए अनुग्रह की ओर, हे यविष्ठ।
english: Whoever today makes for you a ghee-filled cake, O god of auspicious flame, O Agni, lead him forward to something better, towards the favour allotted by the gods, O youngest.
notes: apūpa rendered "cake" (a sacrificial offering); vasyas "better thing" could be "wealth". bhadraśoce literally "O one of auspicious flame".

words.gram: n. loc. sg. pres. part. pass. √śaṃs

hindi: उसे हिस्सा दो, हे अग्नि, सौश्रवसों में; हर उक्थ में, जब पाठ किया जाए, हिस्सा दो। वह सूर्य में प्रिय, अग्नि में प्रिय हो; उज्जात से, जनित्वों से वह फूटकर निकले।
english: Give him a share, O Agni, in the renowns; in each hymn, when it is recited, give a share. May he be dear in Sūrya, dear in Agni; may he burst out with the ujjāta, with the janitvas.
notes: The second line is obscure. bhavāti ujjātena bhinadad ujjanitvaiḥ is split as shown but uncertain; ujjāta ("up-born") and janitva ("births") are kept transliterated. Sūrya and Agni are locatives (agnā an older locative). The input has a double space after sūryḙ; it is attached to the previous token src. ukthe ukthe "in each hymn" (uktha is the sandhi form).

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. √iṣ

hindi: तुम्हें, हे अग्नि, यजमानों ने दिन-दिन स्थापित किया; सारा धन, सब वांछित वस्तुएँ। तुम्हारे साथ धन चाहते हुए उत्सुक जनों ने गायों वाले बाड़े को खोल दिया।
english: You, O Agni, the sacrificers have placed day after day; all wealth, all desirable things. With you, seeking wealth, the eager ones opened up the pen rich in cows.
notes: Line 1 construction is unclear: tvām may be the object of dadhire, with vasu and vāryāṇi in apposition; or the sacrificers received the wealth through Agni. Rendered literally with a semicolon.

hindi: अग्नि की स्तुति की गई, जो मनुष्यों के लिए अति सुखकर है, वैश्वानर, ऋषियों द्वारा, सोम का रक्षक। द्वेषरहित भाव के लिए हम द्यावापृथिवी को पुकारें; हे देवो, हमें उत्तम वीरों वाला धन दो।
english: Agni has been praised, very kind to men, Vaiśvānara, by the sages, guardian of Soma. For freedom from hatred we would call Heaven and Earth; O gods, bestow on us wealth rich in good heroes.
notes: somagopāḥ is read as a nominative singular epithet of Agni (as in unit 22); it could also be read as nominative plural with ṛṣibhiḥ. suśeva "very kind" is approximate. narām taken as genitive plural "of men".

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √jan

hindi: अग्नि गरजा, जैसे गरजता हुआ द्यौ; पृथ्वी को चाटता हुआ, वनस्पतियों को सजाता हुआ। तुरन्त उत्पन्न होता हुआ, प्रज्वलित होकर उसने दोनों लोकों को प्रकाशित किया; वह अपनी दीप्ति से भीतर चमकता है।
english: Agni roared like thundering Heaven, licking the earth, anointing the plants. Born at once, kindled, he lit up both worlds; with his light he shines within.
notes: Same text as units 6 and 21. vi akhyat ā rodasī: "lit up the two worlds" is the plain rendering; alternative: "looked over".
